notes: States describe DX2Ed, not T3Ed. T3Ed icon/resource presence is evidence of an authoring workflow, not proof of DX2 binary compatibility. No retail assets included.

capabilities.title: Actor class palette and property browser

capabilities.next_step: Complete typed inheritance and default property value resolution; assign validated native archetypes to new actors; build guarded GMP/IBD package writer with in-game roundtrip.

capabilities.title: Editable level project/source format
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed persists transform/property and IBD placement designs in private JSON. DX2SDK v0.2 independently generates source-verified original GMP actors.json, and v0.1+ exposes source-SHA-bound editable multi-actor native Location plans. These are private editor/SDK project files, not native level sources or an UnrealEd/T3Ed replacement.; v0.35 full synthetic project save/reopen smoke covers rotated face-resized brush, original prop preview move and orthographic workspace.
capabilities.next_step: Unified authoring project integrating source-verified assets, placements, dialogue and script designs with reversible native writers; GMP/IBD remain authoritative for runtime

capabilities.next_step: Validate native Unreal brush data, implement additive/subtractive CSG, DX2 BSP/collision build and runtime-tested map output.

capabilities.title: Vertex, face, polygon edit
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed v0.35 editor-only face In/Out on Box/Wall/Floor draft brushes (six local-axis faces) with anchored opposing plane, undo/redo and private JSON project round-trip; source T3Ed ModeFaceDrag reference. Native BSP face/vertex mesh authoring remains missing. v0.37: Alt+Shift viewport click selects local six-axis face of only the already-selected editor-only Box/Wall/Floor, rotation-aware, then Inspector In/Out changes dimensions; real Godot synthetic smoke. v0.38: custom concave Polygon draft brush with 3-32 editable local footprint vertices, bounded XZ coordinate UI, insertion/deletion, triangulated top/bottom and side preview mesh, Undo/Redo and strict private project save/reopen; synthetic Godot test. v0.39: selectable editor-only Polygon footprint handles and a top-plane viewport drag in Top/Perspective; world X/Z grid snapping, validated live preview, one Undo/Redo transaction and synthetic real-Godot smoke.
capabilities.next_step: General 3D polyhedral vertex/edge editing, per-surface material/UV authoring and independently proven native BSP/zone/CSG cooking remain missing; custom polygon tools are private Godot drafts only.
